text: 上海金融监管局网站发布《推动上海银行业保险业数字金融高质量发展的若干措施》，《若干措施》提出，上海金融监管局将探索建立数字金融评价体系，对数字金融发展水平和成效进行监测分析。加强督促指导，对政策落实不到位、执行走偏等问题予以纠正。强化监督管理，对相关风险及违规经营行为采取风险提示、监管约谈、监管通报、行政处罚等措施。
text_en: The Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau website published the "Several Measures for Promoting the High-Quality Development of Digital Finance in Shanghai's Banking and Insurance Industries." The measures state that the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau will explore the establishment of a digital finance evaluation system to monitor and analyze the level and effectiveness of digital finance development. It will strengthen supervision and guidance and correct problems such as inadequate policy implementation and deviations in execution. It will strengthen supervision and management and adopt measures such as risk reminders, regulatory talks, regulatory notices and administrative penalties for related risks and irregular business practices.
